Sending a Christmas card in this case might be seen as insensitive or disrespectful to his new beliefs. By not sending a card, you are showing respect for his decision and acknowledging his changed circumstances. However, it's also important to consider the personal relationship you have with Daniel and whether not sending a card might be perceived as a sign of distance or disconnection. Perhaps a more thoughtful approach would be to send a neutral greeting or a card that acknowledges your relationship and expresses your well-wishes, without specifically referencing Christmas.
